description: This file declares functions for converting YUV image formats to RGB formats, primarily used in image processing within Android environments.

methods.name: ConvertYUV420ToARGB8888
methods.description: Converts YUV420 image data to ARGB8888 format.

methods.name: ConvertYUV420SPToARGB8888
methods.description: Converts YUV420 semi-planar data to ARGB8888 format.

methods.name: ConvertYUV420SPToARGB8888HalfSize
methods.description: Downsamples YUV420 semi-planar data to half the size in both dimensions, outputting ARGB8888.

methods.name: ConvertYUV420SPToRGB565
methods.description: Converts YUV420 semi-planar data to RGB565 format.
